description: Source code implementing Wi-Fi thermostat control and discovery functions, including SSDP discovery, HTTP communication with thermostats, state retrieval, and monitoring threads.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatStartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts SSDP discovery for thermostats, registers callback.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatStateGetState
methods.description: Retrieves current thermostat state via HTTP request.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatStartMonitoring
methods.description: Begins monitoring a thermostat's state and IP address changes.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatSetCoolSetpoint
methods.description: Sets the cooling setpoint on the thermostat.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatSetHeatSetpoint
methods.description: Sets the heating setpoint on the thermostat.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatSetSimpleMode
methods.description: Enables or disables simple mode on the thermostat.

methods.name: rtcoaWifiThermostatStateDestroyState
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for thermostat state.
